comment: Dedicated game servers the server runs alongside itself: copy to gamespy-sessions.json beside the database and edit (docs/gamespy-server.md, 'Sessions'). This machine has no GPU: a dedicated PSPC runs with --renderer none (docs/gamespy-server.md, 'Dedicated servers'). Each needs a GameSpy account, made from 'accounts', and an infrastructure.json that sends *.gamespy.com to 127.0.0.1 (its own XDG_CONFIG_HOME, so that it does not go through the tunnel). The command here is an example: the disc, memory stick and options are yours.
